## Less AI hype. More business value.

##### Financial Services

FINANCIAL SERVICES

### **86%**

**less time processing investor requests**

AI classifies emails, summarizes attachments and drafts responses, with analysts in control.

2 minutes per request. 99.5% compliance with committed service times.

##### Banking

BANKING

### **45%**

**less ATM maintenance processing time**

AI validates maintenance requests, compares before-and-after photos and helps anticipate failures.

Supporting 2,820 ATMs and 10,816 maintenance jobs a year.

##### Energy & utilities

ENERGY & UTILITIES

### **50%**

**less grid-connection processing time**

Connects applications, approvals and payments in one digital workflow spanning eight systems.

Also reduced customer service time by 75%.

##### Banking

BANKING

### **90%**

**less time on restricted-list checks**

Automatically checks customers against restricted and security lists during credit applications.

98% of cases require no manual intervention.

##### Insurance

INSURANCE

### **900 hours**

**estimated annual time savings**

Streamlines supplier onboarding with automated checks and generated risk assessments.

Replaces manual searches, screenshots and PDF compilation.

##### Real estate

REAL ESTATE

### **95%**

**less invoice processing time**

AI reads and translates invoices, then suggests property and supplier codes for analyst review.

From 15–20 minutes to 1 minute per invoice, across 30+ languages.
